Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1048
Claimant:
Yvonne Miller
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
9 Jun 2023
Claim opened after a rear-end collision reported at a signalized intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck from
behind by a sedan, and the claimant reported a knee injury from the impact. The driver is named on the policy, so
coverage is being confirmed on that basis.
5 Jul 2023
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision and records the other
driver's account of the sequence.
29 Jul 2023
Recorded statements taken from the other driver and two independent witnesses. All three describe the collision the
same way as the initial report.
26 Aug 2023
Scene photos and the vehicle damage photos received from the insured. Nothing in the photos suggests prior
damage to the vehicle, and no earlier damage is known from the file.
28 Aug 2023
Claimant is represented by counsel. Future contact is to go through the attorney's office. Medical authorization forms
requested.
11 Sep 2023
Claimant's recorded statement taken through counsel. The account is consistent with the original report, and some
additional details were given that were not in the first notice of loss, but the core sequence did not change.
2 Nov 2023
Medical records received. The reported knee injury fits the type and force of a rear impact of this kind. No prior
treatment to the same body area appears in the records reviewed so far.
22 Nov 2023
Treatment followed a typiacl course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. Records show improvement over time
and the frequency of care tapered as the claimant recovered.
7 Jan 2024
Repair estimate reviewed with the shop. Some of the listed damage may not be fully attributable to this impact, so the
line items are being checked against the collision photos before a final figure is set.
17 Jan 2024
Confirmed with the underwriting file that the policy was in force on the loss date and that nothing points to damage
occurring before coverage began. Coverage position is unchanged.
24 Jan 2024
Liability and injury evaluation sent to counsel for review. Next step is a respnose on the settlement demand within the
timeframe set by the file.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
